page.title: Ingress Drift
page.purpose: Compare live ingress with the exposure manifest and ownership ledger, then make adoption, ignore, or prune decisions with clear consequences.

priorities.statement: The source of every hostname is visible.
Managed, external, ignored, and unmanaged states are distinct.
Prune is visibly destructive and requires confirmation.
